name: ClubHub
summary: Event management for university clubs and student societies
text: Event management for university clubs and student societies. Society organisers track RSVPs, ticketing and attendance in spreadsheets; ClubHub replaces them with one dashboard.

name: RSVPly
summary: Simple RSVP pages for small events
text: Simple RSVP pages for small events. Create an RSVP page in a minute, send reminders by email and export the guest list.

name: Ask HN: tool for student society events?
summary: Request for a tool to run student society events
text: Request for a tool to run student society events. I run a university robotics society and we are frustrated with managing event sign-ups across WhatsApp and Google Forms. Is there a tool for this?

name: campus-calendar
summary: Open-source shared calendar for campus groups
text: Open-source shared calendar for campus groups. A self-hosted calendar that lets university groups publish events and students subscribe via iCal.

name: Eventbrite
text: Global ticketing and event platform. Eventbrite lets organisers sell tickets, manage check-in and promote events worldwide. Series funded, large company.

name: ShelfLife
summary: Track pantry expiry dates to cut food waste
text: Track pantry expiry dates to cut food waste. Scan groceries, get reminders before food expires, and see recipes for what is about to go off.

name: Ask HN: I wish there was an app for leftover food
summary: Complaint about food waste at home
text: Complaint about food waste at home. We throw away so much food. I wish there was an app that tells me what to cook with leftovers before they spoil.

name: fridge-tracker
text: Barcode based fridge inventory tracker. Python app that scans barcodes and tracks expiry dates of items in your fridge, with Telegram alerts.

name: TooGoodToGo
text: Marketplace for surplus restaurant food. Restaurants sell unsold food at a discount through the app at the end of the day.

name: InvoiceNinja Lite
text: Invoicing for freelancers. Open source invoicing, time tracking and payment reminders for freelancers and small agencies.

name: Ask HN: frustrated with chasing late invoices
text: Freelancers complain about late payments. As a freelance designer I spend hours chasing clients for late invoices. Frustrated with manual reminders.

name: PayLater Reminders
text: Automatic polite payment reminders. Connect your invoices and send automatic polite follow-ups until the client pays.

name: TaxBuddy
summary: Tax filing assistant for gig workers
text: Tax filing assistant for gig workers. Estimates quarterly taxes for gig workers and files returns. Seed funded.

name: StudyGroupFinder
summary: Find study partners for your courses
text: Find study partners for your courses. Match with classmates taking the same courses and schedule study sessions.

name: flashcard-ai
text: Generate flashcards from lecture notes. Upload lecture PDFs and get spaced-repetition flashcards generated automatically.

name: Ask HN: is there a tool to turn lecture slides into quizzes?
text: Students want quizzes from slides. Is there a tool that turns my lecture slides into practice quizzes? Existing tools are too expensive for students.

name: Quizlet
text: Study tools and flashcards. Popular flashcard and study platform used by millions of students. Growth stage.

name: ClinicQueue
text: Online queue for small clinics. Patients join a virtual queue and get an SMS when the doctor is ready.

name: Ask HN: tool for small clinic appointment reminders
text: Clinics struggle with no-shows. Small clinics lose money from no-shows; is there a cheap tool to send appointment reminders by SMS?

name: open-ehr-lite
text: Lightweight electronic health records. Minimal open-source EHR for small practices. Handles patient records and prescriptions.

name: CodeReviewBot
text: Automated pull request review comments. A GitHub app that leaves lint and style review comments on pull requests.

name: Ask HN: tired of flaky CI tests
text: Developers complain about flaky tests. Our CI is full of flaky tests and nobody knows which ones. Is there a tool that detects and quarantines flaky tests?

name: FlakeHunter
text: Detect flaky tests in CI. Analyses CI history to find flaky tests and auto-quarantine them.

name: PlantPal
text: Watering reminders for house plants. Identify plants from a photo and get watering and light reminders.

name: Ask HN: roommates splitting chores fairly
text: Complaint about chore splitting. Living with four roommates, we keep arguing about chores. I wish there was a fair chore rotation app.

name: chore-wheel
summary: Chore rotation bot for shared houses
text: Chore rotation bot for shared houses. Discord bot that rotates chores between housemates and tracks completion.

name: CryptoSignals Pro
text: Trading signals for crypto. AI generated buy and sell signals for crypto traders. Not financial advice.

name: tradebot-x
text: Automated crypto trading bot. Connects to exchanges and runs grid trading strategies automatically.

name: ResumeTailor
summary: Tailor your CV to each job post
text: Tailor your CV to each job post. Paste a job description and get a tailored resume and cover letter.

name: Ask HN: internship applications are a black hole
text: Students frustrated with internship search. I applied to 80 internships and heard back from 3. Is there a tool to track applications and follow-ups?
